import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_N = 7;
    static final int MAX_2N = 1 << MAX_N;
    static final int MAX_M = 100;
    static final int MAX_S = 64184;
    
    static final int[] SIZES = {0, 5, 11, 37, 137, 821, 7529, 164184};
    static final int MAX_SZ = 164184;
    
    static int len;
    static long[][] bfs = new long[MAX_S][];
    static long[][] what = new long[MAX_SZ][];
    static int[] ind = new int[MAX_SZ];
    static int[][] next = new int[MAX_2N][MAX_S];
    static int[] match = new int[MAX_S];
    
    static long[][] p = new long[MAX_N][MAX_M];
    static long[] prev = new long[MAX_S];
    static long[] cur = new long[MAX_S];
    
    static long powmod(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        a %= MOD;
        for (; b > 0; b >>= 1) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) res = res * a % MOD;
            a = a * a % MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    static int bit(int n) {
        return 1 << n;
    }
    
    static long[] bitu128(int n) {
        long[] p = new long[2];
        p[n / 64] |= (1L << (n % 64));
        return p;
    }
    
    static int get_ind(long[] state) {
        int pos = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
            int bit = (int)((state[i / 64] >> (i % 64)) & 1);
            pos = (pos * 2 + bit) % SIZES[6];
        }
        while (true) {
            if (Arrays.equals(what[pos], state)) {
                break;
            }
            if (what[pos] == null) {
                what[pos] = state.clone();
                bfs[len] = state.clone();
                ind[pos] = len;
                len++;
                return len - 1;
            }
            pos++;
            if (pos == SIZES[6]) pos = 0;
        }
        return ind[pos];
    }
    
    static void precalc(int n) {
        int N = bit(n);
        long[][] fixed_size = new long[MAX_N + 1][];
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_N; i++) {
            fixed_size[i] = new long[2];
        }
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
            int cnt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((mask & bit(i)) != 0) cnt++;
            }
            long[] temp = bitu128(mask);
            fixed_size[cnt][0] |= temp[0];
            fixed_size[cnt][1] |= temp[1];
        }
        
        int sz = SIZES[n];
        for (int k = 0; k < sz; k++) {
            what[k] = null;
        }
        len = 0;
        
        long[] one = new long[2];
        one[0] = 1;
        get_ind(one);
        
        for (int k = 0; k < len; k++) {
            long[] state = bfs[k];
            long[][] pred_hall = new long[n][];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                pred_hall[i] = new long[2];
            }
            
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                long[] temp = bitu128(mask);
                if ((state[0] & temp[0]) != 0 || (state[1] & temp[1]) != 0) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        long[] temp2 = bitu128(mask | bit(i));
                        pred_hall[i][0] |= temp2[0];
                        pred_hall[i][1] |= temp2[1];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                long[] nxt = new long[2];
                nxt[0] = state[0];
                nxt[1] = state[1];
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if ((mask & bit(i)) != 0) {
                        nxt[0] |= pred_hall[i][0];
                        nxt[1] |= pred_hall[i][1];
                    }
                }
                
                next[mask][k] = get_ind(nxt);
            }
            
            for (int i = n; i >= 0; i--) {
                long[] temp = fixed_size[i];
                if ((state[0] & temp[0]) != 0 || (state[1] & temp[1]) != 0) {
                    match[k] = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static long expectedMaximumMatching(int n, int m) {
        Arrays.fill(prev, 0);
        prev[0] = 1;
        
        int N = bit(n);
        
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
            
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                long prob = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if ((mask & bit(i)) != 0) {
                        prob = prob * p[i][j] % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prob = prob * ((MOD + 1 - p[i][j]) % MOD) % MOD;
                    }
                }
                
                for (int k = 0; k < len; k++) {
                    cur[next[mask][k]] = (cur[next[mask][k]] + prob * prev[k]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            
            System.arraycopy(cur, 0, prev, 0, len);
        }
        
        long ans = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < len; k++) {
            if (match[k] == n) {
                ans = (ans + prev[k]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = n;
        
        precalc(n);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                p[i][j] = sc.nextLong() * powmod(100, MOD - 2) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        long ans = expectedMaximumMatching(n, m);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
